'''Dueling''' was a combat sport favored by denizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It was popular on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was the favorite sport of [[Zayne Carrick]]. [[Gorse Bendak]], [[Goethar Kleej]], and [[Rohlan Dyre]] were three famous duelists. The [[Franchise]] was a [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]]-run dueling league.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
